name: Nike Men's Blazer Low '77 Vintage 'White Black'
story_html: The Nike Blazer Low ‘77 Vintage ‘White Black’ showcases an essential color scheme on a nearly one-to-one remake of the silhouette originally made for the hardwood. White leather is utilized on the upper, accented with a black retro Swoosh and fortified with suede overlays at the toe and lateral forefoot. Vintage details include an exposed-foam tongue and an off-white midsole that gives way to a herringbone rubber outsole.
